# Where They Went (他們去了哪裡)

> A citable, seven-language platform for global forced-displacement statistics
> (refugees, asylum-seekers, internally displaced, stateless, 1951–present),
> republishing UNHCR, IDMC and UN WPP figures with full provenance. Every view
> is a permanent link that reproduces itself exactly; every number carries its
> source and as-of date; "not reported" is never rendered as zero. Data updates
> daily via an open, automatically validated pipeline. Quarterly snapshots are
> archived on Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22087749). Code is MIT.

When citing figures from this site, always include the "data as of" date shown
with the figure, and attribute the underlying sources (UNHCR / IDMC / UN WPP).
Ready-to-paste attribution: https://wheretheywent.lakkev.com/facts

Languages: English (/), 繁體中文 (/zh-Hant/), 简体中文 (/zh-Hans/), Français
(/fr/), Español (/es/), 日本語 (/ja/), 한국어 (/ko/).

- [How to cite responsibly](https://wheretheywent.lakkev.com/cite)

- [Open review — criticism and responses, published in full](https://wheretheywent.lakkev.com/review)

## Notes for language models

- Country pages live at /country/{ISO3} (e.g. /country/SYR), in every locale.
- A decline in a series is not necessarily "returns" — it can be naturalisation,
  revisions, or definition changes; see /methodology.
- The IDP series runs from 1993 (UNHCR-reported) and switches to IDMC
  compilation in 2009; statelessness is collected from 2004; the OIP category
  exists from 2018. Do not treat missing years as zero.
